description_en: Queries the evaluation results of a rule against resources from the rule dimension
description_zh: 从规则维度查询规则对资源的评估结果
kebab_example: aliyun config list-config-rule-evaluation-results --compliance-type NON_COMPLIANT --next-token IWBjqMYSy0is7zSMGu160000 --max-results 10 --config-rule-id cr-cac56457e0d900d30000 --compliance-pack-id cp-f1e3326622af00cb0000 --regions cn-shanghai --resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance --resource-group-ids rg-aek2indxn3g0000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConfigRuleEvaluationResults

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: Compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: Non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: Not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data.
IGNORED: Ignored
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en: If the response is truncated, you can use `NextToken` to send a subsequent request to retrieve the remaining results from the point of truncation
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in a single request. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For information about how to obtain a rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For information about how to obtain a compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en: The regions to which the evaluated resources belong. Separate multiple regions with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源所属地域，多个地域之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en: The resource types of the evaluated resources. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源的资源类型，多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The resource group IDs to which the evaluated resources belong. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源所属的资源组ID，多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids

EvaluationResultList.description_en: The list of rule evaluation results

Annotation.description_en:
The supplementary information about the non-compliant resource. The following information may be included:

`configuration`: The actual configuration of the resource, which is the non-compliant configuration.
`desiredValue`: The expected configuration of the resource, which is the compliant configuration.
`operator`: The comparison operator between the actual configuration and the expected configuration.
`property`: The JSON path of the current configuration in the resource property struct.
`reason`: The reason for non-compliance
Annotation.description_zh:
不合规资源的补充信息。可能包含以下信息：

`configuration`：资源当前实际配置，即资源不合规配置。
`desiredValue`：资源期望配置，即资源合规配置。
`operator`：资源当前配置和期望配置之间的比较运算符。
`property`：当前配置在资源属性结构体中的JSON路径。
`reason`：资源不合规原因

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: Compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: Non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: Not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data.
IGNORED: Ignored
ComplianceType.description_zh:

NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略

ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the rule was triggered for evaluation. Unit: milliseconds
ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_zh: 规则被触发执行评估的时间戳。单位：毫秒

EvaluationId.description_en: The unique ID of the evaluation result

EvaluationResultIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the rule evaluation result

EvaluationResultQualifier.description_en: The resource information in the rule evaluation result
EvaluationResultQualifier.description_zh: 规则评估结果中的资源信息

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance package to which the rule belongs

ConfigRuleName.example: ECS实例CPU核数满足最低要求

IgnoreDate.description_en: The date on which the ignored evaluation result is automatically restored, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD. An empty value indicates that the result is not automatically restored and must be manually restored
IgnoreDate.description_zh: 已忽略评估结果的自动恢复日期，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD。为空表示不会自动恢复，需要手动恢复

RegionId.description_en: The region ID that indicates the resource ownership

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The resource group ID that indicates the resource ownership

ResourceOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID that indicates the resource ownership
ResourceOwnerId.description_zh: 资源归属的阿里云账号ID

OrderingTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp displayed on the timeline. Unit: milliseconds
OrderingTimestamp.description_zh: 时间轴展示的时间戳。单位：毫秒

InvokingEventMessageType.description_en:
The trigger type of the rule. Valid values:
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: configuration change.
ScheduledNotification: periodic execution.
Manual: manual trigger
InvokingEventMessageType.description_zh:
规则触发机制。取值：
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：配置变更。
ScheduledNotification：周期执行。
Manual：手动触发

LastCompliantFixedTimestamp.description_en: The time when the resource was most recently remediated to a compliant status, as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds. This value is not recorded when a new resource or rule is evaluated as compliant for the first time
LastCompliantFixedTimestamp.description_zh: 最近一次修复为合规状态的时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒；新资源或规则首次评估为合规时不记录该值
LastCompliantFixedTimestamp.title_zh: 最近一次修复为合规状态的时间，新资源或规则首次评估为合规时该值不会被记录

LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.description_en: The start time of the most recent non-compliant status, as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.description_zh: 最近一次不合规状态的起始时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.title_zh: 最近一次不合规的开始时间

RemediationEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether remediation is enabled. Valid values:
true: Remediation is enabled.
false: Remediation is not enabled
RemediationEnabled.description_zh:
是否启用修正设置。取值：
true：启用修正设置。
false：不启用修正设置

ResultRecordedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the resource evaluation result was generated. Unit: milliseconds
ResultRecordedTimestamp.description_zh: 产生资源评估结果的时间戳。单位：毫秒

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:
1: High risk.
2: Medium risk.
3: Low risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results
